summary: Re-test after auth refactor (localStorage JWT -> httpOnly cookie). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass — login/signup set HttpOnly access_token cookie and return only {user} (no token in body), /auth/me works with cookie & with Bearer fallback & returns 401 without auth, /auth/logout clears cookie (subsequent /me = 401, and /logout itself requires auth). Full itinerary CRUD + Gemini /api/chat + cross-user isolation all green. Frontend E2E (1440x900): signup -> dashboard, httpOnly access_token cookie observed in browser, reload preserves session via /auth/me, prefs -> Generate -> Gemini reply + day-by-day itinerary renders, Save adds sidebar item, Clear + reload saved item works, Delete removes it, Logout returns to /login AND clears cookie, protected route guard redirects unauthenticated user to /login, login with same creds restores session. No regressions vs iteration_1.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for itineraries owned by another user instead of 403. Acceptable hide-existence pattern but inconsistent with /api/users/{id}/itineraries which returns 403. Same as iteration_1.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py set_auth_cookie uses secure=True + samesite='lax' + httponly=True — correct for production HTTPS preview. Confirmed cookie attributes via Set-Cookie header check (HttpOnly present).

CORS middleware uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. Browsers DO accept this because Starlette echoes the Origin back as Access-Control-Allow-Origin (not literal '*'), and the preview URL is same-origin in our test — works in practice. Worth a comment that for stricter prod deployments, pin to an explicit allow_origins list.
server.py /auth/logout depends on get_current_user — good: prevents anonymous cookie-clear pings; returns 401 if already logged out (verified in test_logout_requires_auth).
Login/signup correctly omit `token` from response body — verified by 'token not in body' assertion in tests.
Frontend api.js correctly sets withCredentials:true; AuthContext correctly treats user=null as 'checking' and false as 'guest' to avoid flashing /login during initial /auth/me check.
Iteration_1 noted token in localStorage as XSS risk — that concern is now resolved by the httpOnly cookie move.
Minor: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — consider FastAPI lifespan API (non-blocking).
test_credentials: Generated dynamically: test_e2e_<ts>@example.com / test123. Pre-existing test@odysai.com / test123 was NOT re-verified — current backend_test.py creates fresh users per run. memory/test_credentials.md is stale: still references 'JWT bearer token in localStorage' and {token,user} response shape — should be updated to mention httpOnly access_token cookie and {user} response.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates ~3 fresh users (TEST_/test_ prefix, @example.com) + 1 throw-away itinerary (deleted at end). E2E run creates 1 user. Residual users remain in SQLite (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (10s, 21 tests). Cookie auth verified: signup/login set HttpOnly access_token + return {user} only; Bearer fallback still works; /logout requires auth & clears cookie. Gemini /api/chat takes ~5-15s, use >=60s timeout. Frontend requires >=1024px width (right preferences panel is lg+). One small doc-drift: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still describes the OLD localStorage JWT model — update if needed.
